content: Minimizer/signature bucket skew is severe on real genomes: signature ordering shows max/mean bucket ratio up to ~80 (k=55, m=10), and >90% of k-mers can concentrate in ~50 minimizers (Discount preprint 2020.10.12.335364; Gerbil/AdaOrder 2021.12.02.470910; IIIT binning study). Homopolymer/low-complexity sequence (poly-A tails, adapters) drives the skew. Mitigations in the literature: frequency-based ordering, AdaOrder (Gerbil), Discount binning, KMC-style signature filtering plus sampled frequency histogram bin-packing. For a memory-bounded counter one giant bucket defeats the bound; bucket-size admission plus recursive re-partition of oversized buckets is the standard defense.
